info.name: ACME Project Tracker API
info.description:
Full test flow for the ACME Project Tracker API (FastAPI on AWS Lambda).

**How to use**
1. Import this collection and one environment (local / localstack / aws).
2. Point the API at an EMPTY database (the first admin is created on the first request).
3. Run the collection in order (Collection Runner or `newman run`). Every request checks its own response and stores ids/tokens for the next one.

**Roles used**: admin, two managers (Maria, James), two employees (Alex, Priya). Tokens are kept in collection variables (`admin_token`, `manager_token`, ...).

Each request has saved example responses showing the expected JSON.
